author_biography_short: Sharif Issah Tingane builds software from Wenchi, Ghana, and founded SHARIF TECHNOLOGIES. Public projects include SAIBA, an AI business assistant; Sharif NOVA, an open-source programming language; and CodeCast, an Android app. A public ORCID record lists interests in software development, AI, cybersecurity and networking. This book is for first-time learners.
